headlines.headline: KAWHI LEONARD-TO-RAPTORS TRADE CLEARED TO PROCEED AFTER NBA CONCLUDES CLIPPERS CAP PROBE
headlines.detail: The NBA's salary-cap circumvention investigation into the Clippers has concluded, clearing the path for a Kawhi Leonard trade to Toronto built around multiple first-round picks and swaps. The league fined the Clippers $30 million, suspended owner Steve Ballmer and business-ops president Gillian Zucker for a year, suspended basketball-ops president Lawrence Frank for six months, and stripped L.A. of five first-round picks (2029-2033); Leonard was also disciplined, with the players' union arguing he was misled by his own uncle.

headlines.headline: PACKERS TRADE FOR STEELERS RB KALEB JOHNSON AFTER JOSH JACOBS LANDS ON EXEMPT LIST
headlines.detail: Green Bay acquired running back Kaleb Johnson from Pittsburgh for a 2028 sixth-round pick after starter Josh Jacobs was placed on the Commissioner's Exempt List to open the season, barring him from practicing or playing while his misdemeanor case — stemming from a May altercation — proceeds; his court appearance was moved up to September 10.

headlines.headline: FCS TARLETON STATE STUNS BOWLING GREEN 20-13 IN WEEK 1'S FIRST BIG UPSET
headlines.detail: Tarleton State rushed for 250 yards from Tylan Hines to beat Bowling Green 20-13, the program's second win over an FBS opponent in as many seasons after topping Army in double overtime last year. Elsewhere, No. 2 Oregon trailed Boise State 17-14 at halftime in Eugene, and No. 6 Indiana routed North Texas 52-16 behind TCU transfer QB Josh Hoover's 231 yards and four touchdowns.

headlines.headline: DUKE OPENS ATOP PRESEASON POWER 44 AS TRANSFER PORTAL CHURN CONTINUES INTO SEPTEMBER
headlines.detail: Duke debuts at No. 1 in ESPN analyst Andy Katz's first Power 44 rankings for 2026-27, part of a wave of preseason previews as the offseason transfer market stays active — UConn added Northern Arizona wing Isaiah Shaw and Wofford guard Nils Machowski, while Miami's Acaden Lewis and North Carolina's Matt Able both withdrew from the NBA Draft to return to school. Defending national champion Michigan, which won the 2026 title in March, enters the year as the team to beat.
